classes.label: Point leak detection
classes.description: A sensor detects water only where it is placed and does not itself close the main water line.
classes.safetyBoundary: Placement, battery, network, and notification conditions can affect alerts.

classes.label: Whole-home flow monitoring
classes.description: An in-line device observes water flow across the home plumbing supply.
classes.safetyBoundary: Monitoring alone is not automatic shutoff and does not guarantee every leak is detected.

classes.label: Automatic main-line water shutoff
classes.description: An installed valve can close the main water supply for supported detected conditions.
classes.safetyBoundary: Compatibility, installation, power, connectivity, configuration, and event conditions affect operation.

classes.label: Automatic or seismic gas shutoff
classes.description: A listed residential valve can stop gas flow when its supported activation condition occurs.
classes.safetyBoundary: No DIY gas work; local permitting, utility position, listing, and qualified installation require confirmation.

classes.label: Local fire or smoke alert
classes.description: An alarm sounds at the property and may provide app alerts without central monitoring.
classes.safetyBoundary: Follow alarm instructions and contact emergency services for an emergency; app notification is not dispatch.

classes.label: Professionally monitored fire or security
classes.description: An enrolled service may receive supported alarm signals and follow the provider's response process.
classes.safetyBoundary: Hardware, plan, signal path, certificate, dispatch linkage, jurisdiction, and carrier documentation must be confirmed.

classes.label: Connected-home remote monitoring and control
classes.description: A connected system supports remote status, alerts, or control through an app, hub, local controller, or cloud.
classes.safetyBoundary: Interoperability, outages, subscriptions, account security, privacy, and carrier treatment remain separate checks.

classes.label: Independent SmartDevices protection option
classes.description: Editorial guidance that may help a selected concern but has no carrier applicability claim.
classes.safetyBoundary: Not a carrier requirement, offer, eligibility, or discount determination.
